note: Top navigation bar -- renders: Wikipedia logo, search box, main menu, user links (Donate, Create account, Log in)
Page title bar -- renders: page title, language selector button
Left navigation tabs -- renders: Category, Talk
Right navigation tabs -- renders: Read, Edit, View history, Tools
Appearance settings panel -- renders: Appearance, Font size (Small, Standard, Large), Width (Standard, Full), Theme (System, Light, Dark)
Site subtitle -- renders: From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
Sister site box -- renders: Wikipedia logo, link to sister project
Category description -- renders: fixed editorial text describing the category
Category links -- renders: Categories, list of category names

Footer -- renders: last modified date, rendered with MediaWiki, copyright, privacy policy, about, disclaimers, contact, legal safety contacts, code of conduct, developers, stats, cookie statement, mobile view, Wikimedia Foundation logo, Powered by MediaWiki logo
